name: rosetta-queue-usage
code:
use default

let queue = Queue()

report_empty(pending: Queue[string]) is
    let state = if pending.count == 0 then "yes" else "no" fi

    write_line("empty: {state}")
si

["first", "second", "third"] |> each(item => queue.enqueue(item))

report_empty(queue)

write_line("front: {queue.peek()}")

while queue.count > 0 do
    write_line("dequeued {queue.dequeue()}")
od

report_empty(queue)

use default

let queue = Queue()

report_empty(pending: Queue[string]) is
    let state = if pending.count == 0 then "yes" else "no" fi

    write_line("empty: {state}")
si

["first", "second", "third"] |> each(item => queue.enqueue(item))

report_empty(queue)

write_line("front: {queue.peek()}")

while queue.count > 0 do
    write_line("dequeued {queue.dequeue()}")
od

report_empty(queue)
output:
empty: no
front: first
dequeued first
dequeued second
dequeued third
empty: yes
